Build Stan-Ready Design for a D-Class Joint Bernoulli Resistance Model

Source: R/profile_joint_bernoulli.R
profile_build_design.Rd

The general skeleton: takes a wide S/R outcome matrix and a caller-supplied covariate design, and returns everything a Stan program needs to fit the saturated (or order-capped) log-linear joint Bernoulli model with exact marginalization of untested classes. D – and therefore every interaction count – comes entirely from ncol(Y); this function does not hardcode a panel size or a covariate set. The interaction coefficients (eta) have NO stratum index, so they are shared across every level of whatever fixed-effect stratifier is encoded into X (hospital, state, district, country, or none) – this is the SAME fit regardless of how many strata X represents, never a separate fit per stratum (see profile_build_fixed_effect_design, the recommended way to build X with that stratifier correctly specified).

Usage

profile_build_design(
  Y,
  X,
  class_names = NULL,
  max_order = NULL,
  beta_sd = NULL,
  interaction_sd = function(k) 1.5/(k - 1),
  grainsize = 64L
)

Arguments

Y

Numeric/integer matrix or data frame, N events x D classes, entries in c(0, 1, NA) (susceptible / resistant / untested). Column names become the class labels unless class_names is supplied.

X

Numeric matrix, N x K: the covariate design for the main effects. Entirely up to the caller – build it with model.matrix() from whatever formula is appropriate (age, sex, hospital, ICU, whatever). Must have nrow(X) == nrow(Y).

class_names

Character vector length D, optional (default: colnames(Y)).

max_order

Integer, passed to profile_bernoulli_terms. Default: fully saturated (= D).

beta_sd

Numeric scalar or length-K vector: prior SD for the main-effect coefficients. Default 2.5 for an intercept-like first column, 1.5 for the rest, matching J2-L's convention, but fully overridable.

interaction_sd

Numeric scalar, or a function order -> sd, giving the prior SD for each interaction order's global scalars. Default halves the SD per additional order (function(k) 1.5 / (k - 1)), matching J2-L's 1.5 / 0.75(*) / 0.5 / 0.35 decreasing schedule in spirit ((*) J2-L's order-2 term is actually a separate ICU/location effect, not part of this skeleton's covariate block – fold it into X instead).

grainsize

Integer. Stan reduce_sum grainsize. Default 64L.

Value

A named list, directly usable as cmdstanr/rstan Stan data, plus a manifest data frame (one row per parameter, from profile_bernoulli_terms) and design (the state enumeration + per-order design matrices, for inspection/plotting). Stan list elements: N_events, D, K, S (= 2^D), P (total interaction-term count), X, B (S x D main-effect design), V (S x P concatenated higher-order design), n_compatible, compatible_state (N_events x S, only the first n_compatible[e] entries of row e are used), beta_sd (length K), eta_sd (length P).

See also

The reference Stan model this pairs with: system.file("stan", "joint_bernoulli_general.stan", package = "anumaan")
